shared_or_similar_visual_information: A shaded region with an adjacent unshaded interior cutout or excluded part. On the left, use the gray polygon inside rectangle ABDF beneath the segments AC and CE. On the right, use the light-blue center of the square bordered by four unshaded corner sectors.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It selects the part of the rectangle outside the two unshaded triangular pieces. Right image: It selects the center remaining after removing the four corner sectors from the square.
Rationales: The shade identifies the remainder after leaving designated pieces out of an enclosing geometric area. Those pieces must be removed from the area computation in each panel.
